import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df):
    if not isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame) or df.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input must be a pandas DataFrame with at least one column.")
    
    result_df = df.copy()
    last_col = result_df.columns[-1]

    # Mean imputation for the last column
    imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy="mean")
    col_values = pd.to_numeric(result_df[[last_col]].iloc[:, 0], errors="coerce").to_numpy().reshape(-1, 1)
    result_df[last_col] = imputer.fit_transform(col_values).ravel()

    # Box plot for the last column
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    sns.boxplot(y=result_df[last_col], ax=ax)

    return result_df, ax
